assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production 3D racing game environment texture atlas, exactly a 2 by 2 grid of equal square tiles, filling a square image edge to edge.
Primary request: four detailed original environment surface textures for NIGHTSHIFT: Cell Relay, a high quality night racing world lightly inspired by Nervos CKB's cells and connected network architecture.
Top left tile: dark weathered coastal basalt cliff, rugged stratified stone with subtle cracks and small mineral streaks, slate blue and charcoal.
Top right tile: elegant futuristic green-white data center facade, orthographic straight-on, repeating recessed square cells of glass framed by brushed graphite, tiny mint lights, precise panel seams, no perspective.
Bottom left tile: shipping container wall, deep desaturated teal industrial metal, close-up straight-on repeating vertical corrugations, restrained rust and weathering.
Bottom right tile: futuristic road tunnel wall, graphite ceramic and concrete panels, slim horizontal mint light strips, refined engineering seams, slight wear.
Style/medium: physically plausible AAA game environment albedo textures with restrained built-in shading, sharp fine material detail, not an illustration or scene.
Composition: four equal square quadrants, no gutters, no margins, each tile a repeatable material sample; tiles have consistent scale and no objects crossing quadrant boundaries.
Constraints: no text, no lettering, no logos, no road, no cars, no people, no watermark, no strong perspective, no giant glowing symbols. Keep midtones visible, surface details subtle enough for real-time rendering.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: wide 3:1 panoramic distant backdrop texture for a high quality real-time night racing game.
Primary request: original atmospheric coastal mountain landscape at blue hour, with a very distant cargo harbor on the far left horizon, layered slate mountains in the middle and right, and a vast moody sky. No foreground objects.
Composition: continuous single panorama, exactly 3:1 wide. Upper 65 percent is open blue-hour sky with subtle layered clouds, a restrained pale sunset band just above a low mountain horizon. Bottom 35 percent is distant coastal mountain silhouettes and dark water, with tiny sparse port lights on the far left. All mountains distant, no close cliffs.
Style: cinematic physically plausible environment art, rich subtle gradients, photographic texture detail, restrained dark violet slate and cool ocean blue with a narrow warm peach horizon; readable midtones.
Constraints: no road, no cars, no people, no text, no symbols, no logos, no frames, no watermark, no giant city. Designed to sit behind original 3D track geometry.
